accord.name: Accord
accord.summary: A round brilliant of 1.50 carats lab-grown diamond between two equal companions in matching settings, the open gallery beneath them catching the light they share. Three stones in complete agreement.
accord.description: Three-stone: round centre flanked by two equal rounds, open gallery

alight.name: Alight
alight.summary: 2.50 carats Lab-grown diamond above a fully pavé-set shank, the gallery traced with diamonds beneath the stone. Day to night, without adjustment.
alight.description: Hidden pavé halo, full pavé shank, contrasting-finish setting

amora.name: Amora
amora.summary: A heart cut meets a pear in a toi et moi arrangement that never tries to match. Two distinct shapes, held in balance and left to speak softly to one another.
amora.description: Heart and Pear Diamond Toi et Moi Pendant

amour.name: Amour
amour.description: A full line of round diamonds leads to a heart-shaped centre stone that catches the eye instantly. Romantic, luminous and designed to stand out.

aria.name: Aria
aria.summary: The Aria layers emerald, pear, and round lab-grown diamonds into a compact three-stone composition — playful proportion with a distinctly modern edge.

aster.name: Aster
aster.description: Two pear lab-grown diamonds meet in a softened point, accented by delicate round stones along the band. Feminine and light-catching, with a refined sense of balance.

aura.name: Aura
aura.description: An oval centre stone framed by fine lab-grown round diamonds, set on a polished bangle with clean, quiet structure. Understated brilliance with a classic finish.

aurelia.name: Aurelia
aurelia.summary: Round brilliant lab-grown diamonds form an open circle that feels airy, deliberate, and easy to wear. A classic outline stripped back to light, movement, and a kind of quiet certainty.

aveline.name: Aveline
aveline.summary: A yellow cushion cut lab-grown diamond sits inside a compact halo, suspended in a neat drop. Soft colour, crisp edges, and a quiet glow that stays close.

axis.name: Axis
axis.description: Radiant and emerald-cut diamonds create a clean, architectural repeat with strong symmetry throughout. Sharp, polished and made to feel deliberate.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.summary: Four carats lab-grown diamond above a wide, milgrain-edged band — engraved, architectural, unignorable. This ring doesn't compete for attention.
bastion.description: Wide milgrain-edged band, raised solitaire, pavé inner gallery

bellavie.name: Bellavie
bellavie.summary: An open heart built from marquise lab-grown diamonds and vivid pink accents, drawn with a sharper hand. Romance, pared back until it feels modern.
bellavie.description: Bellavie Marquise and Round Diamond Heart Pendant

bijou.name: Bijou
bijou.summary: Two cuts, one earring. The Bijou pairs a pear and emerald cut stone side by side — a micro toi et moi you wear every day.

bloom.name: Bloom
bloom.summary: An oval of 2.50 carats lab-grown diamond above a solitaire setting with a hidden pavé halo at the gallery base, the shank splitting gently beneath before rejoining. The stone rises from the band the way a flower rises from a stem.
bloom.description: Solitaire, hidden pavé halo at gallery base, split bypass shank

blush.name: Blush
blush.summary: A fancy pink oval Lab-grown diamond of two carats, flanked by an arrangement of marquise and round brilliant diamonds. Warm in colour. Considered in every other decision.
blush.description: Oval center, marquise and round brilliant cluster on each shoulder

braid.name: Braid
braid.summary: An oval of two carats lab-grown diamond flanked by two pear-shaped diamonds, the whole setting raised above a rope-twist shank that runs the full length of the band. Texture beneath. Light above.
braid.description: Three-stone: oval centre, two pear sides, rope-twist shank full length

brio.name: Brio
brio.summary: Three ovals, bezel-set in a loose cluster — the Brio has the energy of scattered petals and the precision of fine jewellery.

cadence.name: Cadence
cadence.description: Round lab-grown diamond clusters repeat between polished links, creating a structured rhythm across the bracelet. Graphic, modern and sharply composed.

calise.name: Calise
calise.summary: Lab-grown Baguette diamonds run in clean rows, framed by round stones and wrapped into a barrel silhouette. Graphic and controlled, with just enough brilliance to soften the line.

cameo.name: Cameo
cameo.summary: A marquise of two carats lab-grown diamond in a vintage-detailed setting, six round brilliant accents set into milgrain-edged shoulders that continue along the shank. Every detail is placed with intention.
cameo.description: Vintage setting: milgrain-edged shoulders, six scattered round brilliant accents

celestia.name: Celestia
celestia.summary: A blue oval centre sits inside a double halo of white lab-grown diamonds, deepened by contrast and light. Rich in tone, but still composed against the skin.

celie.name: Celie
celie.description: A round and pear shaped lab-grown diamond sit side by side on a pavé band, bringing contrast to a classic two-stone ring. Softly modern, with just enough spark.

cerise.name: Cerise
cerise.summary: A fancy pink oval lab-grown diamond of 6.07 carats, flanked by two half-moon diamonds in an open gallery setting. Rare in colour. Uncompromising in scale.
cerise.description: Three-stone: large pink oval centre, two half-moon diamond sides, open gallery

cherie.name: Cherie
cherie.description: A heart-cut centre framed by marquise and round accents creates a soft, radiant spread of light. Delicate in scale, but full of feeling.

citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.summary: Over two carats lifted on cathedral shoulders, the shank dissolving into pavé beneath. A single Lab-grown diamond sits concealed at the junction of stone and setting — found only by those who look.
citadel.description: Cathedral six-prong, pavé shank, concealed diamond at gallery junction

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.summary: A convex dome entirely buried in lab-grown diamonds — 322 round stones per pair. The Cloud is the most tactile, most abundant piece in the DIAMA earring range.

coil.name: Coil
coil.summary: The band twists beneath a pavé-set round brilliant, parting and meeting again around the finger. Three-quarters of a carat feels entirely unhurried in this setting.

colette.name: Colette
colette.summary: A pink cushion cut lab-grown diamond surrounded by white lab-grown diamonds is suspended cleanly between two side links. The colour brings softness; the structure keeps it poised.

cora.name: Cora
cora.summary: A single heart cut lab-grown diamond sits low in a minimal setting that lets the stone carry the feeling. Simple, direct, and a little disarming.

dew.name: Dew
dew.description: Round bezel-set lab-grown diamonds are spaced along a fine chain for a lighter take on everyday brilliance. Soft on the wrist, with an effortless glow.

elara.name: Elara
elara.summary: Graduated round stones rise into a gentle curve that sits like a small gesture at the neck. Minimal, fluent, and quietly bright.

elise.name: Elise
elise.summary: A yellow cushion cut Lab-grown diamond is framed by a close halo and suspended from a slender diamond-set bail. Small in scale, but warm with colour and intention.

ellipse.name: Ellipse
ellipse.description: An open oval centre is traced with pavé lab-grown diamonds for a silhouette that feels fluid and sculptural. Sleek, light and quietly distinctive.

embrace.name: Embrace
embrace.description: A pavé-set knot sits at the centre of a lab-grown diamond-lined bangle, bringing softness to a sculptural silhouette. Refined, fluid and designed to hold the eye.

estelle-1.name: Estelle
estelle-1.summary: Round lab-grown diamonds map a cross in a stripped-back, close-to-the-skin setting. Devotional in feeling, modern in line, and easy to wear every day.

flora.name: Flora
flora.summary: The Flora arranges lab-grown pear cut diamonds into a five-petal bloom — light-catching from every angle with a sweetness that still feels refined.

kaia.name: Kaia
kaia.summary: A bold architectural frame — a rounded oblong outline completely filled with pavé. The Kaia is structure and sparkle fused into one stud.

liora.name: Liora
liora.summary: The Liora gathers a princess center with marquise petals into a bright, sculpted cluster — a floral silhouette that feels both crisp and luminous.

loma.name: Loma
loma.summary: A cushion cut stone drops from a long clean bar — the Loma is architectural length, worn as an earring.

lovell.name: Lovell
lovell.summary: The Lovell nestles a heart cut stone into a gold hoop frame — wearable romance for every day, not just occasions.

luma.name: Luma
luma.description: A single larger round lab-grown diamond anchors the centre of a fine tennis line for a balanced, luminous finish. Quietly classic, with one clear focal point.

luna.name: Luna
luna.summary: A pear cut stone drops from a clean gold hoop — the Luna is the earring that catches light before anything else in the room.

mira.name: Mira
mira.summary: The Mira pairs a pear cut lab-grown diamond with a slim huggie hoop — stones that point forward, quietly commanding every room.

mosaic.name: Mosaic
mosaic.description: A line of mixed lab-grown diamond shapes — emerald, marquise, pear, heart and oval — set in a rhythmic sequence of light. Bold in composition, yet refined on the wrist.

muse.name: Muse
muse.description: A delicate tennis line finished with a single heart centre for a softer expression of brilliance. Clean, feminine and easy to wear every day.

nova.name: Nova
nova.description: Round lab-grown diamonds sit within hexagonal settings for a bracelet with a sharper, more graphic edge. Structured in detail, yet still elegant on the wrist.

petalia.name: Petalia
petalia.summary: Six pear-shaped yellow lab-grown diamonds gather into a flower that feels more sculpted than sweet. Soft colour meets clean symmetry in a piece that glows rather than shouts.
